_pm_rulings_applied: 08.11.26 (rule 14) - Do not restate the specs and drawings. 42 of the original 55 scope items were struck as duplicates of Section 04 0503, Section 04 2016, the S0-00 general notes, Division 01, or the Subcontract's own terms. What survives is the trade boundary and the one obligation the documents fail to carry.

08.11.26 (rule 14, second half) - Integral water repellent is kept precisely because it is NOT in the manual: Section 04 2016 cross-references 07 19 00 Water Repellents twice and that section does not exist. The Scope of Work narrative is the only place the obligation is written down.

08.11.26 (rule 14a) - Exhibit B, Basis of GMP is an Owner-side agreement and is out of the DIRECTIVES list. Nothing in it is cited. Its testing and special-inspection exclusion is written as its own clause instead.
08.11.26 (rule 16) - Exclusions start empty. 13 of the original 18 were struck. The five kept are the ones a masonry subcontractor would ordinarily assume are his.
08.11.26 (rule 17) - Spec sections carry number and description only, numbers spaced in pairs. Directives are zero-padded with no dates or qualifiers. Paragraphs 27 and 28 are always kept.
08.11.26 (D4) - Supply and install, not Furnish and install.
08.06.26 (D - GLOBAL RULE) - 07 19 00 is absent from the Project Manual and is not cited.
07.31.26 - The entire demolition scope is RFP-008.

scope_groups.header: Building Masonry - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:
items: Supply and install all masonry and masonry accessories at the concessions building as indicated.
Includes stem walls, walls, pilasters, columns, bond beams, masonry lintels, and control joints.
Includes integral water repellent in all block, mortar and grout exposed above grade.
Supply and install all CMU reinforcing required for this Scope of Work.
Coordinate masonry reinforcing laps and dowel layout with Concrete Subcontractor.
Receive, unload and inventory all steel embeds supplied by others.
Includes layout, installation and grouting of all embeds, bearing plates, anchor bolts and sleeves supplied by others.
Includes drypack under bearing plates and solid grouting of beam pockets after structural steel erection.
Layout, install, brace and grout all hollow metal door frames supplied by others.
Coordinate frame delivery with Doors, Frames & Hardware Subcontractor for setting during masonry construction.
Coordinate penetrations, sleeves and chases in masonry with Plumbing, HVAC and Electrical & Low Voltage Subcontractors.
Coordinate surface applied features and smooth face wall returns at entrances, including cameras, speakers, wall pack lights and hose bibs.
Clean and remove debris from top of footings as required to place masonry units.

exclusions: Caulking, sealants and backer rod at masonry
Surface applied waterproofing, sealers and anti-graffiti coatings
Cost of independent testing and special inspection services
Top of wall nailers and pressure treated plywood

review_appendix._purpose: PM request 08.11.26. Rule 14 strips every obligation the specs and drawings already carry. This lists what was stripped so the PM can put any of it back. Draft only -- build with --final to suppress it.
intro: Rule 14 keeps out of this exhibit anything the Contract Documents already state, so the Subcontract carries one copy of each obligation rather than two that can drift.

Every line below was drafted, verified and then removed on that basis. All of them still bind the Subcontractor through the document named beneath them. Tick any that should be restated in the Scope of Work above.

groups.header: A.  Already stated in the Project Manual or on the Drawings
note: Restating these creates a second, weaker copy of the same obligation.

items.item: Provide CMU conforming to ASTM C90, Grade N, medium weight, Type II/V cement, Type I moisture controlled.
Individual units shall attain 2,800 psi compressive strength and the masonry assembly shall attain an f'm of 2,000 psi.
items.flag: Conflict: the spec says 2000 psi minimum for units, S0-00 says 2800 psi. Stricter reading governs.

items.item: Provide fully grouted CMU walls and stem walls.
items.source: S0-00 CMU note 8, grout cells solid in all walls; S3-01 details 1 through 4

items.item: Supply and place all mortar and grout, including test samples, pigment and admixture as specified.
Place masonry control joints at 30'-0" maximum spacing, and not within 4'-0" of any wall opening.
items.source: S4-00 detail 5 note 1; Section 04 20 16 paras 3.10.F and 3.10.G
items.flag: Conflict: the spec allows 40 ft, S4-00 requires 30'-0". Of the items on this page this is the one I would put back.

items.item: Tool all exposed mortar joints to match the existing masonry at the site.
Includes 50 of each size, color and type of unit, delivered to the Owner as extra materials.
items.flag: No bidder mentioned attic stock, so nobody has priced delivering it.

items.item: Furnish and install all non-shrink grout at all embeds set into masonry construction.
items.source: S0-00 steel note 13, non-shrink non-metallic 10,000 psi
items.flag: The grouting obligation itself survives in the scope above; only the product description was struck.

items.item: Verify all mounting heights against the Architectural and MEP drawings.
Furnish and install all wall bracing between CMU wall construction and structural steel erection.
Provide temporary shoring and bracing at all masonry construction and wall openings to resist lateral deflection.
Remove all shoring and bracing after wall mortar has reached design strength.
Provide cold and hot weather protection for all masonry work as specified.
Provide approved, dated and detailed reinforcing steel shop drawings showing sequencing and all areas of work prior to start.
Provide design mixes, product data and manufacturer's certificates for all masonry units, mortar, grout and reinforcement.
Submit 4 samples of block units illustrating color, texture and the extremes of color range.
Construct an 8' x 8' masonry mock-up including mortar, accessories and door framing elements, where directed.
Remove the mock-up at completion of masonry work.
Provide all tests and certifications required for complete and operational systems.
Clean, point up and repair all masonry work as required for application of final finishes by others.
Clean and remove from site all debris and unsatisfactory materials generated from this Scope of Work.
Comply with the requirements of the Geotechnical Report and the Contract Documents; the most stringent requirement shall prevail.
items.source: the Geotechnical Report and the Contract Documents generally
